title: Full Stack Developer (Laravel + Vue.Js)
jobDescription: Job Description: Responsibilities: Develop and implement Backend components using Laravel ensuring scalability, reliability, and security. Build responsive and intuitive user interfaces using Vue.js. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. Knowledge of RESTful APIs and web services. Troubleshoot and debug technical issues. Participate in daily stand up meeting with Clients Requirements: Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer or similar role. Solid understanding of web development fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Strong attention to detail Should be comfortable doing client interaction on daily basis. Compensation: Best as per industry Working Days: 5 Days working, Sat-Sun fixed off Email: [email protected]

title: Golang Developer
jobDescription: Job Description: Responsibilities Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in Golang for Backend development. Develop user interfaces using React and ensure the responsiveness and performance of applications. Knowledge of Node/Angular/Js technology, will be a plus point. Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability. Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers. Troubleshoot and debug issues to ensure smooth operation of software applications. Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in Golang and React development Experience with database technologies such as SQL and No SQL databases. Involve in daily stand up calls Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). Experience having client interaction. Proven experience as a Golang Developer with a strong portfolio of past projects. Knowledge of other frontend frameworks such as Angular or Vue.js. Proficiency in frontend development using React and related libraries/tools. Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and micro services architecture. Experience with database technologies such as SQL and No SQL databases. Knowledge of Python technology, will be a plus point. Compensation: Best as per industry Working Days: 5 Days working, Sat-Sun fixed off Email: [email protected]

title: Wordpress Developer
jobDescription: Job Description: Responsibilities: Develop and Cutomize WordPress themes and plugins from scratch, adhering to best practices and coding standards. Excellent proficiency on OOPs, PHP, MySql, Ajax, JQuery. Experience with WordPress coding standard [hooks and filters] Integrate WooCommerce functionality into WordPress websites and Optimising website performance, responsiveness, and security. Proficient understanding of RESTful APIs and formats(JSON, XML) and code versioning tools (such as Git, SVN, and Mercurial). Interacting with clients on regular basis will be must. Requirements Minimum 5 yrs of experience in building web applications. Relevant Education/qualification. Expertise in WordPress with Plugin Development (WooCommerce ) and theme customization. Good understanding of front-end technologies, including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery will be an advantage Excellent Communication skills Collaborate with designers and content creators to implement website designs and layouts. Troubleshoot and debug issues, ensuring seamless functionality across different browsers and devices. Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in WordPress and WooCommerce development. Compensation: Best as per industry Working Days: 5 Days working, Sat-Sun fixed off Email: [email protected]

title: Chat Support Executive (International Process)
jobDescription: Job Description: Key Responsibilities: Chat Support: Provide efficient and professional chat-based support to clients by promptly responding to inquiries, resolving issues, and addressing concerns. Typing Skills: Exhibit exceptional typing skills to maintain quick and accurate responses during chat interactions. Computer Proficiency Written Communication: Maintain high-quality written communication in English, ensuring clarity, grammar, and spelling are impeccable. Shift Flexibility: Adapt to rotational shifts as part of the international process to ensure 24/7 chat support coverage. Team Collaboration: Collaborate with colleagues and team members to share information, best practices, and knowledge to improve overall customer support quality. Qualifications: Proven experience in chat-based customer support or a related field is a plus. Excellent typing skills with a typing speed of [specify speed] words per minute. Proficiency in computer usage and familiarity with chat support software and tools. Strong command of written English with impeccable grammar and spelling. Customer-focused attitude with excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including nights and weekends, as required by the international support process. Compensation: Working Days:
